rumors.text: A private Blackglass assay supposedly shows concentrations far above the published survey.
rumors.grounding: Conflicting survey datasets genuinely exist; no hidden ancient technology or conspiracy is implied.

rumors.text: Someone is buying Pilgrim land claims despite the system having no known economic value.
rumors.grounding: Claims can be cheap precisely because nobody wants them.

rumors.text: A survey crew says it heard an automated carrier near Accord's planned route.
rumors.grounding: Could be equipment, another expedition, propagation error or wishful interpretation.

rumors.text: Roosevelt Modular still has tooling to build a new R-61 if a customer pays enough.
rumors.grounding: The company manufactures legacy structural replacements, which sustains the rumor.

rumors.text: There is an entire sealed depot deck inside Old Ring that never reopened after Black Week.
rumors.grounding: Several inaccessible service volumes exist, but records account for them.

rumors.text: Prospectors found another Talos-grade mineral field and are sitting on the coordinates.
rumors.grounding: Commercial secrecy around claims is routine.
